## Database citation

Please cite the specific database release used in your work. The complete citation and export formats are available from the <a href="https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21871232" data-umami-event="archive-open">Zenodo record</a>.

**Dataset:** Sušjan, P., Pečan, P., Godeša, A., Ramona Caldana, F., and Jerala, R. *saRNA database*. Version 1.0.0. Zenodo. <a href="https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21871232" data-umami-event="archive-open">https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21871232</a>

## Review article

Sušjan-Leite, P.; Pečan, P.; Godeša, A.; Caldana, F.R.; Jerala, R. Small Activating RNAs: A Curated Database and an Overview of Rational Design Principles. *Molecules* **2026**, *31*, 3249. [https://doi.org/10.3390/molecules31183249](https://doi.org/10.3390/molecules31183249)
